WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT
    s_store_id,
    SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(profit) AS profit,
    SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
    SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT
      store.s_store_id,
      store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price::numeric(10,2) AS sales_price,
      store_sales.ss_net_profit::numeric(10,2) AS profit,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    WHERE store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      store.s_store_id,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
      store_returns.sr_return_amt::numeric(10,2) AS return_amt,
      store_returns.sr_net_loss::numeric(10,2) AS net_loss
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN store ON store_returns.sr_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    WHERE store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  ) AS salesreturns
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(profit) AS profit,
    SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
    SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT
      catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_id,
      catalog_sales.cs_ext_sales_price::numeric(10,2) AS sales_price,
      catalog_sales.cs_net_profit::numeric(10,2) AS profit,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_sales.cs_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_id,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
      catalog_returns.cr_return_amount::numeric(10,2) AS return_amt,
      catalog_returns.cr_net_loss::numeric(10,2) AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
    JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_returns.cr_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE catalog_returns.cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  ) AS salesreturns
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT
    web_site_id,
    SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(profit) AS profit,
    SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
    SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT
      web_site.web_site_id,
      web_sales.ws_ext_sales_price::numeric(10,2) AS sales_price,
      web_sales.ws_net_profit::numeric(10,2) AS profit,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN web_site ON web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    WHERE web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      web_site.web_site_id,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
      CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
      web_returns.wr_return_amt::numeric(10,2) AS return_amt,
      web_returns.wr_net_loss::numeric(10,2) AS net_loss
    FROM web_returns
    LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ON (web_returns.wr_item_sk = web_sales.ws_item_sk AND web_returns.wr_order_number = web_sales.ws_order_number)
    JOIN web_site ON web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    WHERE web_returns.wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  ) AS salesreturns
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT
  channel,
  id,
  SUM(sales) AS sales,
  SUM(returns) AS returns,
  SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT
    'store channel' AS channel,
    'store' || s_store_id AS id,
    sales,
    returns,
    (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'catalog channel' AS channel,
    'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
    sales,
    returns,
    (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'web channel' AS channel,
    'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
    sales,
    returns,
    (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM wsr
) AS x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
